title: Zesty Slovakian Mackerel Stew
description: A savory and shattering one-pot Slovakian dish featuring mackerel, double-rise-bread, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a wok. This stew is a hearty and flavorful meal perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the wok over medium heat and add the chopped onion, cooking until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes, until they begin to soften.
Add the mackerel fillets, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the water to the wok, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, until the fish is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the gluten-free double-rise-bread, breaking it up into small pieces as it absorbs the liquid.
Continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes, until the bread has broken down and the stew has thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
